decisions.executionNote: Remain at origin while observing the demonstrator; sequence not yet established.
Stay still. Demonstrator is approaching the green watch first.
Observe without moving; first object being carried is the green watch.
Wait at origin. Watch is being deposited first; observe the next selection.
Hold both arms at origin. Remember watch first and observe the second object.
Stay motionless. Demonstrator is selecting the phone after the watch.
Wait without moving. Observed order so far: green watch, then phone being carried.
Remain still, remembering watch then phone; phone now in the demo basket.
Continue waiting for the full demonstration; remember watch then phone.
Stay at origin; demonstrator selects gold tank third, after watch and phone.
Observe gold tank being carried third. Keep both arms stationary until demonstration finishes.
Wait at origin. Remember watch, phone, gold tank; observe remaining two selections.
Remain stationary while observing fourth selection. Memorized prefix: watch, phone, gold tank.
Wait at origin. Fourth selection is the dark doll, after watch, phone, and gold tank.
Remain at origin. Observe fourth object, dark doll, being carried; prefix is watch, phone, gold tank, doll.
Continue observing without moving: watch, phone, gold tank, then dark doll being deposited fourth.
Stay stationary. Remember watch, phone, gold tank, dark doll; wait for the last object and demonstrator return.
Stay at origin. Fifth selection is black rectangular device; sequence watch, phone, tank, doll, black device. Wait for demonstration finish.
Wait motionless for fifth deposit and demonstrator return. Memorized order: watch, phone, gold tank, dark doll, black device.
Keep still until demonstrator finishes. Order remembered: watch, phone, gold tank, dark doll, black device.
Fifth object released; continue waiting for the opposite arm to return. Order: watch, phone, tank, doll, black device.
Confirm demonstrator is stationary at origin before starting. Memorized order: watch, phone, gold tank, dark doll, black device.
Demonstrator has returned and stopped. Begin left-arm approach to first target, green watch, with gradual downward wrist rotation and clearance.
Align left gripper above the green watch, gradually completing top-down orientation. Right arm remains parked.
Lower the open left gripper toward the first target watch with a small forward alignment correction; verify before closing.
Finish a cautious descent around the watch and close the left gripper. Retention will be checked visually on lift.
Lift the watch vertically with the left gripper closed; verify it remains retained before transport.
Watch is visibly retained. Carry it over the left policy basket, maintaining clearance and keeping the right arm parked.
Lower the first object into the policy basket and open the left gripper to release the watch.
Watch is released in basket. Lift clear, then approach the second target phone with the left gripper open and align across its width.
Replan from the interrupted pose using smaller increments; continue above the phone with left-arm configuration continuity.
Descend toward the second target phone, with a slight forward correction. Keep the gripper open until aligned near grasp height.
Make a small final alignment and descent, close on the phone, then test retention with a short vertical lift.
Phone is visibly between the fingers. Lift clear of the table with the gripper closed before carrying it to the basket.
Carry the retained phone over the policy basket and align it lengthwise. Keep gripper closed and maintain clearance.
Lower and release the second object, phone, into the basket beside the watch; leave gripper open.
Phone and watch are visibly in basket. Retract left gripper clear while starting right-arm approach to the third object, gold tank.
Complete right-arm top-down alignment above the tank with clearance. Left arm stays over its own workspace.
Lower the open right gripper around the gold tank with a small alignment correction. Left arm remains clear of the placed objects.
Make a small centering correction, close around the tank, and test retention with a short lift.
Tank is retained. Raise and bring it toward a central staging area; prepare the left arm within its workspace for a sequential pickup without crossing arms.
Lower the tank at the center staging area while keeping right EE on the right. Reorient left wrist gradually for pickup and maintain arm separation.
Release the tank onto the central table and retract the right arm before left pickup. Finish left wrist alignment while keeping the arms separated.
Tank is on the central table. Approach from the left with slight wrist tilt while withdrawing the right arm fully into its workspace.
Descend the open left gripper over the staged tank. Keep the right arm stationary and separated.
Fine-align the left gripper around the staged tank, close, and make a short retention-test lift.
Tank is visibly held by the left gripper. Lift and carry it toward an unused rear portion of the basket as the third object.
The tank slipped onto the table during transport. Reapproach its visible new position with the left gripper open; do not advance the sequence.
Descend for a deeper grasp on the tank body rather than its upper turret, keeping the left gripper open for visual alignment.
Close around the lower tank body and test retention with a slow vertical lift before any lateral movement.
The deeper tank grasp appears retained. Continue a slow vertical lift to basket clearance, keeping the left gripper fully closed.
Tank remains retained after the vertical lift. Carry it slowly toward the rear of the basket, with additional rim clearance.
Continue carrying the securely retained tank over the rear basket interior, then begin a gentle descent while maintaining the grasp.
Lower the third object into the rear basket interior and release the tank. Confirm it settles before starting the doll.
Tank has settled in the basket as third. Retract the left arm and align the right gripper across the fourth target doll's torso.
Lower the open right gripper around the doll's torso and finish transverse alignment. Move the left arm to a separated waiting position.
Close on the fourth target doll's torso and perform a slow vertical retention test. Keep the left arm separated and stationary.
Doll is retained after lifting. Bring it toward central staging while aligning the waiting left gripper across its torso; keep arms in separate workspaces.
Lower the retained doll onto the central staging area while keeping right EE on the right. Straighten the waiting left gripper for the subsequent pickup.
The doll slipped onto the table before staging. Reapproach its new visible torso position with the right gripper open; do not advance to the black device.
Lower the open right gripper for a deeper torso grasp on the fallen doll, with a small centering correction.
Doll torso is offset in the wrist view. Lift slightly, recenter the open right gripper, and lower again before closing.
Close around the doll's torso and test the grasp with a slow short vertical lift; confirm retention before transport.
The doll is not retained. Reopen, lift clear, and align the right gripper across its newly rotated torso before another descent.
Use the wrist view to recenter the open right gripper on the doll's torso with small adjustments and a shallow descent.
Fine-center the right fingers across the doll's lower torso, then close and pause before lifting.
Test the centered torso grasp with a slow vertical lift, keeping the right gripper closed and checking the doll visually.
Doll remained on the table after the lift. Reopen and descend deeper around the torso using a small position correction; keep the sequence at object four.
Close at the deeper torso position, pause for settling, and make a small vertical lift to check whether the doll is secured.
Doll appears retained at the deeper grasp. Raise gently, then move slowly toward central staging while maintaining a closed gripper.
Doll remains retained. Lower it at the center for a sequential left-arm pickup; prepare the left arm while preserving separation and staying in each workspace.
Release the fourth object onto the central table and withdraw the right gripper before the left arm approaches.
Doll is staged on the table. Approach its torso from the left at clearance height while withdrawing the right arm into its own workspace.
Descend the open left gripper around the staged doll's torso, with a small tilt to center the fingers while keeping the left EE in its workspace.
Torso is centered between the left fingers. Close at a slightly deeper position, pause, then make a short lift to test retention.
Raise the doll slowly with the left gripper closed, checking that the torso remains captured before lateral transport.
Doll remains held after lifting. Raise for rim clearance and slowly align its length with the basket while moving within the left workspace.
Continue slow transport of the retained doll with extra clearance for its hanging head; finish lengthwise alignment before entering the basket.
Carry the doll fully over the basket interior while keeping its hanging head above the rim and preserving the grasp.
Lower the fourth object into the basket and release the doll gently. Check that it settles inside before handling the final black device.
Doll has been released in the basket as fourth. Retract and approach the final black device with the left arm; begin gradual right-arm return within its workspace.
